summary: Scene line property lookup and value extraction. Scans the line buffer at this+0xC, counting '=' (0x3D) characters; a line with exactly one '=' is dispatched to StringTableLookup_9d10, otherwise sub_559D80 is used. If the chosen lookup returns 0, the function returns 0. On success the lookup result string (pointer at this+0x30C) is strcpy'd into a scratch buffer at this+0x18C, then sub_5897CA locates the '=' delimiter token inside the copy so the value substring can be collapsed in place into the caller-supplied lpSrcStr buffer (and, via a second delimiter scan, into a4). Returns 1 on success.

Dispatch on the equals count: exactly one '=' selects the StringTableLookup_9d10 key=value path; otherwise (0 or >1 '=') the sub_559D80 path.
StringTableLookup_9d10(this, a2) is invoked when the line contains exactly one '=' character.
sub_559D80(this, a2) is the fallback lookup for empty lines or lines not shaped as a single key=value pair.

strcpy the lookup result string (pointer held at this+0x30C) into the scratch buffer at this+0x18C.
sub_5897CA(scratch buffer, asc_5D251C) locates the delimiter token ('=') inside the copied result string.
If the delimiter was found (v11) and the caller supplied lpSrcStr, extract the value substring.
In-place collapse: shift the substring starting at the delimiter position down into the lpSrcStr buffer, copying characters until NUL.
sub_589901(lpSrcStr) processes the extracted first value.
sub_5897CA(0, asc_5D251C) re-locates the delimiter from the global/current position to seed a second extraction.
If the second delimiter hit (v14) is non-null and a4 is supplied, perform a second value extraction into a4.
In-place collapse of the second value substring from v14 down into the a4 buffer, copying until NUL.
sub_589901(a4) processes the extracted second value.
Return 1 to signal success after extraction.
